CE((e.details->>'u')::bigint, (e.details->>'updated')::bigint, 0)
			            + COALESCE((e.details->>'d')::bigint, (e.details->>'deleted')::bigint, 0)
			            + CASE WHEN (e.details->>'c' IS NULL AND e.details->>'inserted' IS NULL) THEN COALESCE((e.details->>'written')::bigint, e.rows_affected, 0) ELSE 0 END
			         ELSE 0 END) AS kafka_total,
			SUM(CASE WHEN e.operation = 'kafka-consumer' AND NOT (COALESCE(e.details->>'buffer_type' = 'snapshot', false) OR COALESCE((e.details->>'is_snapshot')::boolean, false))
			         THEN COALESCE((e.details->>'c')::bigint, (e.details->>'inserted')::bigint, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS kafka_c,
			SUM(CASE WHEN e.operation = 'kafka-consumer' AND NOT (COALESCE(e.details->>'buffer_type' = 'snapshot', false) OR COALESCE((e.details->>'is_snapshot')::boolean, false))
			         THEN COALESCE((e.details->>'u')::bigint, (e.details->>'updated')::bigint, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS kafka_u,
			SUM(CASE WHEN e.operation = 'kafka-consumer' AND NOT (COALESCE(e.details->>'buffer_type' = 'snapshot', false) OR COALESCE((e.details->>'is_snapshot')::boolean, false))
			         THEN COALESCE((e.details->>'d')::bigint, (e.details->>'deleted')::bigint, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS kafka_d,
			SUM(CASE WHEN e.operation = 'kafka-consumer' AND e.status <> 'error' AND NOT (COALESCE(e.details->>'buffer_type' = 'snapshot', false) OR COALESCE((e.details->>'is_snapshot')::boolean, false))
			         THEN COALESCE((e.details->>'written')::bigint, e.rows_affected, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS shadow_written,
			SUM(CASE WHEN e.operation IN ('transmute','transmute_sub') AND e.status <> 'error' AND e.triggered_by <> 'snapshot-hook'
			         THEN COALESCE((e.details->>'written')::bigint, NULLIF(e.rows_affected, 0), COALESCE((e.details->>'inserted')::bigint, 0) + COALESCE((e.details->>'updated')::bigint, 0) + COALESCE((e.details->>'deleted')::bigint, 0)) ELSE 0 END) AS master_written,
			SUM(CASE WHEN e.operation IN ('transmute','transmute_sub') AND e.status <> 'error' AND e.triggered_by <> 'snapshot-hook'
			         THEN COALESCE((e.details->>'inserted')::bigint, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS master_inserted,
			SUM(CASE WHEN e.operation IN ('transmute','transmute_sub') AND e.status <> 'error' AND e.triggered_by <> 'snapshot-hook'
			         THEN COALESCE((e.details->>'updated')::bigint, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS master_updated,
			SUM(CASE WHEN e.operation IN ('transmute','transmute_sub') AND e.status <> 'error' AND e.triggered_by <> 'snapshot-hook'
			         THEN COALESCE((e.details->>'deleted')::bigint, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS master_deleted,
			SUM(CASE WHEN e.operation IN ('transmute','transmute_sub') AND e.status <> 'error' AND e.triggered_by <> 'snapshot-hook'
			         THEN COALESCE((e.details->>'skipped')::bigint, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS master_skipped,
			SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'error' AND (e.details->>'split_retry')::boolean IS NOT TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dlq_count
		FROM enriched e
		GROUP BY 1
	),
	recon_daily AS (
		SELECT
			TO_CHAR(r.checked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' + (420 * INTERVAL '1 minute'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day_str,
			COUNT(*) AS total_runs,
			SUM(COALESCE(r.missing_count, 0)) AS missing,
			SUM(COALESCE(r.stale_count, 0)) AS stale,
			SUM(COALESCE(r.healed_count, 0)) AS healed
		FROM cdc_system.cdc_reconciliation_report r
		WHERE r.checked_at >= NOW() - (14 * INTERVAL '1 day')
		  AND ('shadow_traitestces'::text = '' OR r.shadow_schema = 'shadow_traitestces')
		  AND r.shadow_table = 'export_jobs'
		GROUP BY 1
	)
	SELECT
		d.day_str AS date,
		COALESCE(a.snapshot_shadow, 0) AS snap_shadow,
		COALESCE(a.snapshot_master, 0) AS snap_master,
		COALESCE(a.kafka_total, 0)     AS kafka_total,
		COALESCE(a.kafka_c, 0)         AS kafka_c,
		COALESCE(a.kafka_u, 0)         AS kafka_u,
		COALESCE(a.kafka_d, 0)         AS kafka_d,
		COALESCE(a.shadow_written, 0)  AS shadow_written,
		COALESCE(a.master_written, 0)  AS master_written,
		COALESCE(a.master_inserted, 0) AS master_inserted,
		COALESCE(a.master_updated, 0)  AS master_updated,
		COALESCE(a.master_deleted, 0)  AS master_deleted,
		COALESCE(a.master_skipped, 0)  AS master_skipped,
		COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0)      AS recon_runs,
		COALESCE(a.dlq_count, 0)       AS dlq,
		COALESCE(r.missing, 0)         AS missing,
		COALESCE(r.stale, 0)           AS stale,
		COALESCE(r.healed, 0)          AS healed
	FROM dates d
	LEFT JOIN act_daily a ON a.day_str = d.day_str
	LEFT JOIN recon_daily r ON r.day_str = d.day_str
	ORDER BY d.day_str DESC;
